exposure: N-terminal precursor of B-type natriuretic peptide
outcome: Pulmonary valve diameter z-score at fetal echocardiography
cohort: 34 fetuses with conotruncal-CHD (22 ToF and 12 D-TGA) and 36 healthy controls
finding: This study newly describes increased cord blood TGFβ concentrations in ToF compared to D-TGA and normal fetuses.
